card.name: Compass words before range limits
card.fires_on: Directional words like northern, eastern or extreme, and linking words like from or to, in geography text about the edge or extent of a region or species range. The next word is likely boundary, border or limit.

modes.label: Compass word at range edge
modes.description: A direction such as northern or eastern, often followed by -most, describing the outer end of a territory or range.
modes.example: occurring in parts of Mexico, Central and South America, the Caribbean, and at the<< northern>> end of its range in southern Florida.

modes.label: Linking word in range spans
modes.description: A word like from or to that starts or joins the extent of a boundary or range.
modes.example: The international boundary from the Rocky Mountains<< to>> the Pacific is described by the Oregon Treaty

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying boundary, border or limit next.
card.plain: It fires on direction words in geography text where the next word is likely a border or limit.
